question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

A hole or tunnel dug by a small animal to live in
solution:
The correct answer is: Burrow

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Burrow means a hole in the ground made by certain animals, for example, rabbits, in which they live.

 
 
• Example - *Rats had **burrowed** into the bank of the river.*
 
 
 
• So, it is clear that the 'Burrow' can be used as a one-word substitute for '**A hole or tunnel dug by a small animal to live in**​'

Therefore, the correct answer is option 1.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• Den means the place where certain wild animals live, for example, lions.
 
• Shed means a small building that is used for keeping things or animals in.
 
• Cave means a large hole in the side of a cliff or hill, or under the ground.
